text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's once again time for summer training
camp. I'm
making preparations for
Sweep Tosho's training,
when...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too! If there's anything you
need, you
have but to ask!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whether it be a tire, a barbell, or even a
giant
tuna! You name it and I'll get it for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine Kawakami Princess joined
summer camp
for her own sake. I let her
know she should focus
on her own
training, but...
choice_data_list: Thanks, but don't worry, I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. Please allow me to
assist you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After all, Sweep promised to cast a spell
on
someone for me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to do my part to help make that
magic
take effect! ...Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears nothing I say will make her
budge—it
reminds me of a certain
someone else I know.
Since she insists, I
ask her to do some pair running
with
Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wheeew! You're so fast, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After they start running, the gap
between Sweep
Tosho and Kawakami
Princess quickly widens.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The main purpose of pair running is to
feel the
adrenaline of running in an
actual race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But with Kawakami Princess five lengths
behind
Sweep Tosho the whole time,
they may as well
not be running
together at all at this point.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do another lap, Familiar.
choice_data_list: Maybe the gap in skill was just too wide...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now, hurry up and get ready!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their second lap goes much the same.
Kawakami
Princess can't close the gap
after they begin
running.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you sleeping on the job?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's not that she can't compete. She's actively trying not to compete.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're scared, right? You're afraid of
running
beside me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you wouldn't be holding
back and
running in such a lame way.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: N-no! It was nothing that serious!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is my warning and my vow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I wanted to win
at all
costs. Unable to suppress my thirst
for battle, I
forced it... and I ended up
crashing into someone
from your year.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After that, I made a vow! I vowed never
to lose
control of myself and run in a
way that would
cause anyone trouble
ever again.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What the heck?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you, stupid?! Do you honestly
think you
can compete like that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The world of racing isn't only about
playing it
safe! You're fighting with your
body, and there's
always the risk of
running into someone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But we're all willing to take that risk!
Didn't she
tell you there was nothing to
worry about?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
E-even still, it was my fault for forcing
the fight.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So what?! What's wrong with that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not like you hit her on purpose, so
how long
are you gonna keep letting this
weigh on you?!
You didn't learn
anything from what
happened—you're
just moping around!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're just making excuses! You're
saying
whatever is convenient to help
you avoid looking
at your actual
weakness!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you keep holding back and let
someone else
take the lead, are your
dreams ever gonna come
true?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, right?! How can you help anyone if
you can't
even value your own feelings?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami. You have to come watch the
autumn
Tenno Sho. That's an order!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you remember what it feels like
to wanna
win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're never gonna be any use
to me in
this shape!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuugggh! It's like everyone and their
mother
needs magical help! It never
ends!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Once you're better, I'm gonna put you
to work for
a thousand years!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is fired up and ready for
the autumn
Tenno Sho. And so, we
begin our summer training
camp.
